transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It's my lower back — I've been getting a stiff, aching pain across it for the last 10 days or so. It started after I lifted some heavy bags of compost in the garden.
Do you have any allergies, or have you ever had a bad reaction to a medicine?
No, I don't have any allergies that I know of, and I've never had a bad reaction to a medicine.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 0 is no pain and 10 is the worst pain you can imagine, how bad is your lower back pain?
I'd put it at about a 6 out of 10. It's worst first thing in the morning.
Do you take any medicines regularly?

Yes, I take gliclazide 80 mg twice a day and metformin 1 g twice a day, both for my type 2 diabetes. And since the pain started I've been taking ibuprofen 400 mg three times a day, which I got from the chemist.
Have you noticed any other symptoms along with the back pain?

No, nothing like that. I've had no numbness around the back passage or groin, no trouble passing urine or controlling my bowels, and no weakness in my legs. I've also had no fever and haven't lost any weight.
What, if anything, makes your back pain worse?
Bending makes it worse, and so does getting out of the car. It eases off when I lie on my side or use a hot water bottle.
Other than your diabetes, is there anything else about your health in the past that you think I should know?
Yes, about 5 years ago I had a similar episode of back pain, and that settled with physiotherapy.
What, if anything, worries you most about your back pain?
What worries me most is whether I've slipped a disc, and whether I need a scan to find out. It's been going on for over a week now and I can't do any of my gardening.
Is there anything else about your past health that you think I should know?
No, that's everything as far as I know — just the type 2 diabetes and that earlier back problem 5 years ago.
Are there any other medicines you take, including ones you buy yourself or take only now and then?
No, that's the lot. Just the gliclazide and metformin for my diabetes, plus the ibuprofen I've been taking since the pain started. I don't take anything else.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
